She is allergic to hazelnuts; the Instagram post didn't list nuts clearly. He wants the exact ingredients and a call today on 98400 12345. Check the recipe and allergen labelling, and call him today.
emails.draft_reply:
Dear Karthik,

I am so sorry to hear about your daughter, and I'm very relieved she is fine now. Thank you for letting me know. I will call you today on the number you gave, and I will share the full ingredient list for those brownies. I'm also going to review how we list allergens on our posts and packaging.

With sincere apologies,
Amudha
Amudha's Home Bakes
